summary: Free.ai grants 30,000 tokens/day after a free email signup (6,000/day if you stay anonymous). No credit card. Tokens reset every 24 hours and can be spent across 400+ tools; free accounts also cap heavy tools at 1 video, 2 music tracks, 5 images, and 5 image edits per day. A free account unlocks the OpenAI-compatible developer API at api.free.ai, which shares the same daily pool. The API docs How-it-works line says "Purchase tokens, then generate your key," but the same page's FAQ and rate table list a Free plan at 30K tokens/day and $0.
claim_steps: Sign up at free.ai/signup with an email (no password or credit card; they send a link to set a password later).
Use the 30,000 daily tokens on the site, or open free.ai/api/ to generate an sk-free- API key.
Call https://api.free.ai with the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/ endpoint (and other tool endpoints) until the daily pool resets.
